task_title: Exclude failure-branch-only CI cell ci-act from owed-cell NOT-COLLECTED accounting
task_criteria: The QA harness owed-cell roster (derive_owed_cells) no longer lists ci-act as an owed cell when absent, because the battery emits ci-act only from act-failure branches of the ci-pass cell (a green or skipped CI simulation never emits it, so the NOT-COLLECTED row was spurious on every green fire, per lore-qa-2026-11-22-20-12-17 ledger). Verify: replaying the roster derivation over the harvested lore-qa-2026-11-22 battery script no longer yields ci-act; ci-pass remains owed; bash -n passes; evidence recorded in docs/qa/evidence/run-QA-LORE-8. Failure condition: a genuinely dropped cell still yields no NOT-COLLECTED row (e.g. ci-pass absent with roster derived). Proof: before/after replay output plus md5 before/after of the harness.
